proofs.quote: Slack free-plan history visibility is limited to recent messages and files. Short official quote: "most recent 90 days". Data older than one year is deleted on a rolling basis, a separate limit from search visibility. The official notice dates this deletion change to August 26, 2024.

Slack free workspaces can select one-year retention without edit/deletion tracking, or deletion after 90 days. Paid data is retained for workspace lifetime by default; custom deletion timelines and permitted message-channel overrides can shorten this. Short official quote: "lifetime of your workspace by default". Enterprise-sponsored Slack Connect messages have an exception. The page does not certify every free workspace current default configuration.
